unit: one UID and one processing or visualization stage
budget_accounting: Charge admitted model requests and candidate checks before dispatch, including failures; no refunds or resets on resume.

quota_resume.eligible: Unfinished stage with remaining benchmark budgets; documented provider quota exhaustion, settled requests/checks and known usage.
quota_resume.clock: Exclude only recorded provider-quota waits; preserve unused stage time. All other interruptions count.
quota_resume.during_pause: No inference polling, solver work, candidate checks, edits or hints.
quota_resume.evidence: generation_events.jsonl: provider error evidence, UTC pause/resume times, wall-time offsets, counters and state hashes.
quota_resume.unknown_usage: Block pending reconciliation; never assume zero.

scope_note: Quota-resumable contract for new runs. Existing pinned runs require explicit, recorded migration; historical evaluations are not retrospectively certified. This file is not an enforcement supervisor.
